podcast.title: Co-founding International Submarine Band
podcast.body: John Nuese co-founded the International Submarine Band with Gram Parsons while they were students at Harvard. This group is widely recognized as one of the earliest country rock bands. "Parsons and John News formed what many considered to be one of the earliest country rock bands, whether Graham liked the term or not, called the International Submarine Band."
